title: EVVM Ghost Kitchen
tagline: Mobile-first Ghost Kitchen dApp powered by EVVM virtual payments and signatures.
description: EVVM Ghost Kitchen is a decentralized, mobile-first application that reimagines how on-chain services interact with virtual payments. Built on top of the EVVM (Ethereum Virtual Virtual Machine) protocol, this project demonstrates a sophisticated architecture where service logic (ordering food) is cryptographically decoupled from payment logic (virtual settlement), yet executed atomically in a single transaction.
how_its_made:
Key Technical Features:
Mobile-First Experience: A fully responsive, dark-mode dashboard built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, designed for real-world usage scenarios.
Dual Nonce System: The app implements EVVM's advanced nonce logic, allowing users to switch between Synchronous Nonces (for strict sequential ordering) and Asynchronous Nonces (for high-priority, out-of-order execution).
